Under legacy semantics, both the default `"auto"` and explicit `"multiindex"` resolve to `"multiindex"`, so `flat_snapshots` is false. `create_model` retains the unchanged `as_index(n, snapshots, "snapshots")` result and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders; the added context does not flatten component data in this mode. Changes within builders do not change which snapshots `create_model` hands them.
